decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the firm's established dumper know-how, service capabilities and customer base, it is more likely to be improved than withdrawn.
This articulated construction dumper builds directly on existing engineering and market knowledge, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from early sales and refine it.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the firm's core offer, so withdrawal risk is much higher, but the firm's in-house R&D, underground-equipment orientation and innovative industry context still make continued development plausible.
The compact telescopic loader fits the firm's established product logic of specialized, customer-adapted compact machinery, so management would likely keep it on the market and iterate.
